$comment: Third-party skills, MCP tools and workflows assessed in docs/11-community-skills.md. Every entry under `skills` must carry a license from `license_allowlist` (scripts/validate.py enforces it); anything else goes under `excluded` with a reason. tier: instructions | scripts | plugin. category: retrieval | graph | memory | methodology | diagrams | restraint. safety.outbound_network: none | gateway-only | optional-gateway | third-party. Verified 2026-09-11.
$comment_dependency_lists: Used by scripts/license_audit.py for dependency trees. `extra` are permissive ids that only appear in package metadata; `warnlist` is weak copyleft that warns (fails with --strict). Everything else fails.

enterprise_requires.install: pinned version or vendored clone; no curl|sh on managed machines

serena.purpose: LSP-backed MCP tools: find/reference symbols, read and edit at symbol level, project memories; read one function instead of a file

opencode: mcp.serena = { type: local, command: [serena, start-mcp-server, --context, ide-assistant, --project, .] }; tools: { "serena*": false }; enable per agent
claude-code: claude mcp add serena -- serena start-mcp-server --context claude-code --project <path>

serena.overhead_note: ~25 tool schemas per request when enabled; scope to build/test-writer agents
serena.notes: README: do not install from plugin marketplaces. Check `serena start-mcp-server --help` for context names on your version.

graphify.purpose: Local AST knowledge graph of the repo with visualization; query it instead of re-reading files; docs/PDF/image extraction optional via LLM

safety.hooks: optional git hooks you install (graphify hook install)

graphify.notes: Pick this or code-review-graph. Add graphify-out/** to watcher/.claudeignore; `graphify update .` after pulls. Commercial platform exists but is not required.

code-review-graph.purpose: Self-updating tree-sitter code graph served over MCP: blast radius, callers/dependents/tests affected, semantic search; no LLM calls

cli: cd <project> && code-review-graph install --platform opencode   # or claude-code | codex | cursor | gemini-cli …

safety.hooks: optional save/commit hooks and watch daemon
safety.writes_instruction_files: injects graph-aware rules into client instruction files (review the diff)

code-review-graph.overhead_note: ~30 tool schemas per request when enabled; scope per agent

beads.purpose: Git-backed dependency-aware issue graph for agents (bd); persistent task memory across sessions and parallel agents

cli: brew install beads   # or: npm install -g @beads/bd

safety.writes_instruction_files: bd init appends a workflow snippet to AGENTS.md (review and relocate)

beads.notes: Young project; read migration notes before upgrading

claude-context.purpose: Hybrid BM25 + dense-vector semantic code search over AST-chunked code via MCP; Merkle-tree incremental sync; for very large repos where a graph or symbol lookup is not enough
requires: Milvus (Apache-2.0, local docker) or Zilliz Cloud
embedding model: Ollama (nomic-embed-code / Qwen3-Embedding, Apache-2.0) or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (the gateway)

mcp: npx -y @zilliz/claude-context-mcp@<version>  with EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=Ollama (or OpenAI + OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1) and MILVUS_ADDRESS=http://localhost:19530

safety.telemetry: check env for opt-out on your version
writes: index in Milvus; local sync state

claude-context.overhead_note: few tools; index build costs embedding calls once, then incremental
claude-context.notes: Third retrieval option next to Serena (symbols) and a code graph (structure). Keep embeddings local for Confidential/Restricted repos

superpowers.purpose: Auto-triggering methodology skills: brainstorming, writing/executing plans, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, subagent-driven development, worktrees, code review
superpowers.notes: One methodology pack only. Remove overlapping local skills to avoid duplicate triggers

spec-kit.purpose: Spec-driven development: constitution → specify → clarify → plan → tasks → analyze → implement → converge, artifacts in specs/

cli: cd <project> && specify init . --integration opencode --force   # claude | codex | cursor | gemini | copilot …

spec-kit.notes: Per-feature workflow; no cost when unused. Pin the release tag

compound-engineering.purpose: Brainstorm → plan → work → simplify → review → compound loop; learnings ledger in docs/solutions/

aidlc-workflows.purpose: AWS AI-Driven Development Life Cycle: /aidlc runs 5 phases / 33 stages with approval gates, 14 agents, audit trail; artifacts under aidlc/
requires: opencode>=1.17 | claude-code | codex>=0.145 | cursor | kiro | copilot

unix: sha256sum $tmp/install.sh   # compare with the release page
cd <project> && aidlc config --harness opencode   # claude | codex | cursor | kiro | kiro-ide | copilot
offline: download aidlc-runtime-X.Y.Z.tar.gz from releases; copy runtime/<harness>/ into the project

aidlc-workflows.recommended_model_upstream: Claude Opus 4.8 (use coder-frontier via the gateway)
aidlc-workflows.notes: Heavyweight; multi-week features and regulated work

archify.purpose: Validated architecture / workflow / sequence / data-flow / lifecycle diagrams as self-contained HTML from JSON IR the agent writes

writes: diagram HTML/PNG/SVG where you point it (suggest docs/diagrams/)

archify.notes: Pairs with the architect and docs-writer agents; check generated HTML loads no remote assets

ponytail.purpose: Always-on 'write less code' decision ladder plus /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt
requires: node on PATH for Claude Code / Codex hooks
ponytail.notes: Rules stack with AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md wins on conflict. Benchmarks are the project's own

oh-my-openagent.reason: License is not OSI-approved (fails gate 1). Bundles a third-party web-search MCP (Exa) that cannot be routed through the gateway; replaces the agent set in this repo. Fork alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim: check its LICENSE before considering.

caveman.reason: Measured benefit 8.5% of output tokens on real agentic tasks (JetBrains 2026-07) against 1-1.5k input tokens of rules every turn; proxy component is BSL-1.1. Write AGENTS.md tersely instead.
